items.text: Shadow 823 to 822 (live Forever gear stats, -0.2%), #24 to #25 of 28 as Frost Mage climbs past; still B band. Smite 652 to 651 (#28, C). New snapshot 10 Nov, engine a667dce, client 70862, including the 9 Nov hotfixes.
Blizzard's 9 Nov hotfixes: Shadowform no longer breaks when you cast Fear Ward, and Power Infusion now persists on allies.

Blizzard's 9 Nov hotfixes: XP from every dungeon enemy kill up 50%; the Drowned City's creatures no longer hit about 30% too hard; Deathless Marrow encounter made easier; Shaper's Terrace rares now drop loot. Levelling and dungeon tips updated to match.

Demonology 949 to 963, #9 to #8 (A), still the best Warlock spec. Affliction 906 to 910 stays #14 but moves from A to B as the band lines shift; Destruction 897 to 896 (#17 to #16, B); Destruction on Incinerate 859 to 857 (#19 to #21).

Arcane 926 to 929 (#13 to #10, A), still the best Mage spec but only 1 DPS ahead of Fire; Fire 915 to 928 (#15 to #13, B to A); Frostfire 807 to 820 (#23 to #22). Frost 715 to 816 (+14%, #27 to #24, C to B): MythicSim credits +12.9% to a new reference that stands in Cone of Cold range and casts it at five Winter's Chill stacks, a sim change not a game change. Blizzard's 9 Nov Arcane Concentration fix costs Arcane 1.2% in the sim.

Elsewhere on the list: Retribution 1065 to 1028 (S to A, leaving Survival weave the only S spec); Shockadin 1004 to 982 (#4 to #7); melee Survival 923 to 911 (#12 to #17, A to B); Combat Rogue 858 to 904 (#21 to #18) on a new 21/30/0 reference. Blizzard's Affliction, Voidwalker, Hunter pet and Enhancement tuning is still planned for Tuesday 10 Nov; no staff post says it is live yet.

items.text: Blizzard's 10 Nov hotfix: the Revelation enchant is no longer triggered by Vampiric Embrace healing. No other Priest changes.
Blizzard's 10 Nov hotfix: most quests level 48 and up now also reward gold, so there is no need to save quests for 60; Shatterspear Trolls no longer give XP.

Blizzard's 10 Nov hotfix: Wrack damage cut 30% and no longer boosts other DoTs by 10%; while channelled, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick 100% faster. Soul Siphon now boosts Drain Life, Drain Soul and Wrack. Demon pets' base health up about 15%; Bane of Havoc now triggers the global cooldown. Warlock talent and levelling notes updated.

Affliction 910 to 943 (#14 to #10, B to A) despite the Wrack cut (-7.0% in the sim), on a new Bane of Agony rotation (+12.5%). Demonology 963 to 947 (#8 to #9, A), still the best Warlock spec but only 0.4% ahead; Destruction 896 to 890 (#16 to #18, B).
